comment: Stationary petrol refinery cloned from the stock Diesel Refinery (DA_Item_Module_DieselGenerator / BP_Module_DieselGenerator). Edit values here and rerun build.py.

item.descriptionTierComment: Module size shown in the tooltip type line, as stock does for large variants (DA_Item_Module_ElectricGenerator Tier 2 vs. portable default 1). Not the unlock level.

liquidColors.comment: Exact float32 constants of the stock Portable Petrol Refinery (BP_Module_PetrolGenerator_Portable.UpdateLiquid).

strings.comment: The game runs with LanguageType=German. A mod string table has no .locres translation, so the source text below is shown in every language.

description.text: Stationäre Raffinerie, die aus organischem Material und Strom Benzin herstellt. Ergiebiger als die tragbare Benzinraffinerie, braucht aber mehr Strom.
